Assessing Your Body: Fat, Fit, or Fine? 277

The easiest time for women to lose hip and thigh fat is during the last

trimester of pregnancy and while breastfeeding. At those times, the activ-

ity of the fat-storing enzymes drops, and the activity of the fat-releasing
enzymes increases. In this way nature is protective of a woman’s ability to
care for her offspring.
